record.region: South Asia, Central Asia and Caucasus
record.endpoint_type: reported trade resumption; exact date contested
record.scope: Freight through Petrapole–Benapole; directional onset differs. No passenger or whole-frontier prohibition established.

record.official_rationale: Traders protested customs gate-pass procedures and delays. Trade and protectionism is analyst coding of the stated commercial grievance.
record.context: Deliberate withholding of cross-border trade to pressure customs; January 8 action remains a separate lead.
record.uncertainty: Onset January24/25 and resumption January29/30 conflict. Ittefaq places reverse-direction halt only January29. Month precision preserves disagreement; no uninterrupted two-way spell.

followup_reviews.Root decision: Accept six parents and seven phases, both targeted existing-record findings, and all 32 guarded challenger refinements. Remove the July 31 webpage update from last-confirmed evidence; retain an explicitly qualified July 29–30 onset bound, unknown reopening and withheld numeric duration. Classify that incomplete phase as a bounded interval with an unknown endpoint. Add the explicitly attributed January 2021 employment rationale alongside trade/transport grievances, preserving the UNB URL alias as one article. Retain all Hili clock/day-count conflicts, the June 2025 partial-versus-complete stoppage distinction, the two separate January 2018 questions, six unresolved issues and seven unlocated phases. These are six scoped parent episodes, not evidence that every passenger or every national crossing was closed.
